note: Primitive campground on Bureau of Reclamation land at the foot of Gray Reef Dam on the North Platte, run by Natrona County, about 27 miles southwest of Casper via WY-220 and County Road 412. Barrier-free fishing pier; small boats launch from the campground and a boat ramp sits half a mile downstream. The reservoir above the dam rises and falls daily. --Claude
